label: Population, 2023
definition: Persons enumerated in the 2023 census (headline count).

label: Population, 2017
definition: 2017 census population, as re-tabulated by PBS on 2023 district boundaries.

label: Annual population growth, 2017-2023
definition: Compound annual growth between the 2017 and 2023 counts over a six-year interval.

label: Area
definition: Area reported by PBS.

label: Population density
definition: Population divided by reported area.

label: Urban population share
definition: Share of the population living in areas PBS classifies as urban.

label: Sex ratio
definition: Males per 100 females.

label: Persons per household
definition: Population divided by the number of households in Tables 22-25. PBS publishes 6.33 nationally but does not state its method in these tables, so expect small differences from PBS's figures.

label: Literacy rate (10+)
definition: Literate persons aged 10 and over as a share of all persons aged 10 and over.

label: Female literacy rate (10+)
definition: Literate women and girls aged 10 and over as a share of all women and girls aged 10 and over.

label: Male literacy rate (10+)
definition: Literate men and boys aged 10 and over as a share of all men and boys aged 10 and over.

label: Literacy gender gap
definition: Male minus female literacy rate (10+). Positive means men are ahead.

label: Out-of-school children (5-16)
definition: Children aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all children aged 5-16.

label: Out-of-school girls (5-16)
definition: Girls aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all girls aged 5-16.

label: Out-of-school boys (5-16)
definition: Boys aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all boys aged 5-16.

label: Persons with a disability
definition: Persons reported with a disability as a share of the population covered by Table 16.

label: Households lit by grid electricity
definition: Households whose main source of lighting is electricity.

label: Households lit by solar
definition: Households whose main source of lighting is solar.

label: Households cooking with piped gas
definition: Households whose main cooking fuel is natural gas.

label: Households cooking with firewood
definition: Households whose main cooking fuel is firewood.

label: Improved drinking water
definition: Households whose main drinking-water source PBS classifies as improved.

label: Drinking water on premises
definition: Households whose drinking-water source is inside the dwelling or compound.

label: Households with a flush toilet
definition: Households with a flush toilet.

label: Households with no toilet
definition: Households with no toilet facility.

label: Pakka (permanent) housing
definition: Households living in pakka (fired brick or concrete) structures.

label: Households renting
definition: Households living in a rented dwelling.

label: Households in one room
definition: Households living in a dwelling with a single room.

label: Dwellings owned by women
definition: Share of privately held dwellings (owner-occupied, rented or rent-free) whose owner is a woman. Table 25 reports owner's sex for exactly these three tenure types.
